text:
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt blocked: missing artifact for release v3.12.0 (staging -> canary). CI job postsubmit-dedupe failed with retryable error.
sofia: Ugh. Any logs?
alex: Paste from the postsubmit job: 
```
ERROR: dedupe step failed: duplicate resolution timeout
2026-03-21T15:03:22Z repo: artifacts lookup returned 404 for key=wheel-3.12.0-cp39-manylinux.whl
Caused by: s3: HeadObject 404 Not Found
```
maria: That wheel is produced by the wheels pipeline — I see the job succeeded upstream but the registry index shows two entries with different digests. Looks like a dedupe pass tried to collapse them and lost the pointer.
jeff: Is this the same dedupe race we saw last month? If so the quick unblock was to pin promote to the last-good wheel digest.
sofia: Can we pin from the UI? deploy-bot refused to promote because it validates artifact presence.
ale x: (typo) alex: yes, you can, but it needs a manual override: `deployctl promote --image-tag canary --artifact-digest sha256:<good>` or use the console to force the digest.
maria: Two options: 1) manual pin to the known-good digest (fast, low risk), 2) rerun the dedupe job and hope it reconciles (slower, may flake).
jeff: Given it's a release window and QA already signed off on the build, I'd vote for pin-and-promote, then follow up with a postmortem.
sofia: Agreed. What about the rollout window / change window? PM asked to avoid late-night cuts. We're at 17:10 UTC.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: change window for releases closes at 18:00 UTC unless approved by oncall. React with :white_check_mark: to request extension.
maria: I'll request the extension with product. Meanwhile I'll prepare the digest to pin.
ale x: alex: pinging CI: `ci re-fetch-artifact --key wheel-3.12.0-cp39-manylinux` shows both blobs present in storage but one has an empty index pointer. We can point the index to the working blob.
sofia: Steps for the manual pin? Leave them here so SRE can execute.
ale x: alex: 1) Identify good digest: `s3api head-object --bucket artifacts-prod --key wheels/...` 2) Run `deployctl promote --artifact-digest sha256:<good> --target canary --force` 3) Run smoke e2e `make smoke-canary` 4) If OK, promote to prod during approved window.
maria: I'm escalating to product for the extension now. tagging @product to confirm.
sofia: I'll run smoke once you push the pin. jeff, can you standby for rollback steps if smoke fails?
jeff: On it. If smoke fails: 1) run `deployctl rollback canary --to-digest sha256:<prev>` 2) alert support and open an incident.
maria: Product approved extension until 19:00 UTC. Confirmed by PM in DMs.
eng-oncall-bot: Extension logged by oncall: +60m.
maria: Done the pin and re-ran the promote command. deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded -> canary.
deploy-bot: Promotion completed: release v3.12.0 promoted to canary with artifact sha256:abc123... Smoke tests queued.
sofia: Smoke returned green locally, running CI smoke next.
sofia: CI smoke passed on canary. All good from QA.
jeff: Proceeding with prod promote at 18:30 UTC once change window is open. I'll coordinate the rollout and watch metrics.
maria: I'll file a short postmortem for the dedupe race and propose a fix: make the dedupe step idempotent and add a quick index-repair tool.
sofia: Thanks everyone — marking thread resolved after prod promote. :thumbsup:
